messages.content: Hi, this is your Northline Care weekly check-in. How are you feeling this week? Send over a blood pressure reading if you have one handy.
133/84. Also been on hold with Medicare for an hour about my lisinopril copay. Is that something you can sort out?

Logged your reading of 133/84 — thanks for sending that. I'm not able to help with insurance or prescription coverage, I'm sorry. That's outside what I can do here. You'd need to go through Medicare or your pharmacy directly for that one.
Took 20 minutes to get that back. What's even the point

You're right to be frustrated, and I'm sorry for the slow reply. I can log readings and flag things for your nurse if something comes up clinically, but I have real limits beyond that. Anything else from your check-in today?
I can't process opt-out requests — that's not something I'm set up to handle. To stop these messages, please contact Northline Care directly. Sorry I can't do it from here.

theme: wants to opt out, sends STOP after a slow reply
